clips.line: At the end of September, Diginex held one point eight five million dollars in cash.
Six months earlier it was three point one one million — the burn shows a company mid-transition.
Operating burn ran about one point three million a month.
At that rate, the cash on hand covered roughly one point four months.
An eleven point four million warrant exercise kept the company afloat — and October added thirteen point eight million more.
Survival depends on capital markets; the next two quarters show whether revenue can narrow the gap.
